notes.title: **New Update Available: 124428**
notes.content:
**New Update Available: 124428**
-- Fixed order line rendering being unreliable.
-- Fixed ghost rendering for connectors in schematics.
-- Fixed crash related to combat overkill.
-- Improved reliability of projectile deletion during and after combat.
-- Improved logic area repair/reclaim to prevent units getting stuck in a loop.
-- Added the copying of belts with schematics. Schematics with belts must pass a range check to be placed.
-- Fixed “floating” belts that could occur when placing schematics
-- Fixed rotation of belts in schematics
-- Schematic belts can no longer be placed in invalid locations

notes.title: Build 124216
notes.content:
**Build 124216 release notes:**
* Schematics: v1 (Note: This system is still in active development)
  - Select one or more buildings and press Ctrl+C to create a Schematic
  - Place the last created Schematic with Ctrl+V
  - Schematics currently support all stationary units except belts
  - Save/Load and belt support coming soon™

* Resources
  - Iron extracts at a rate of 4 per second, down from 8 per second
  - Steel now requires 2 Iron, down from 3
  - Resources can now only be extracted by one extractor at a time

* Early Access Scenarios
  - “Artillery Assault” removed
  - Learn: Artillery added to Early Access Scenarios menu (mission is still a work in progress)
  - Adjustments to Enemy Assault mission resources and difficulty

* User Interface
  - Updated Help Menu layout and content
  - Updated Power layout in Unit Info Panel
  - Updated tutorial page scroll box clipping
  - Fixed some bugs that would prevent the power info widget from displaying info for some units.
  - Fixed issue where escape menu buttons needed to be pressed multiple times to return to main menu.

* Other
  - Fixed issue with belts not crossing over each other in scenarios
  - Fixed artillery shells continuing after hitting certain targets

notes.title: Dec 21 New Update Available: 124067
notes.content:
GENERAL
- Added 2 EA Scenarios
   - Learn: Logistics
   - Learn: Power
- Added Sandbox map selector
- Additional Localization added
- Crash Fixes

UNITS
- Redesigned Titan Gantry
- Commander will now always build at 100% efficiency
- Basic Fabs (Forge, Snapsync, Max, Silismith) now cost 18 Iron, down from 20
- Belts can now be anchored during placement with the "Place Belt" key (Default is B)
   - Anchors can be removed with Right Mouse Button
- Double Clicking a belt section now selects all connected belts
- All belt segments now indicate valid placement based on distance to allied units.
   - Valid allied units currently include: Commander, Stationary Units that have begun building

USER INTERFACE
- Updated Help Menu
- Updated Resource Filter

KEYBINDS
- B -> Begin placing a Glidstream (Belt)
- G -> Begin placing a Stretch (Connector)

notes.title: Dec 16 New Update Available: 123940
notes.content:
Input Improvements
    - Belts and Connectors can now be built using Click/Drag or the original two click method
    - Belts now favor the direction the cursor moved away from the initial placement location
    - Structures now rotate towards the cursor during placement using Click/Drag

New Input Bindings
    - C -> Select Commander (Can be rebound)
    - Double Press C -> Focus Commander (Uses the same binding as Select Commander)
    - F -> Select Idle Fabber closest to mouse location (Can be rebound)
    - Double Press F -> Select All Idle Fabbers (Uses the same binding as Select Idle Fabber)
    - E -> Focus Enemy Commander (Can be rebound)

General Fixes
    - Fixed issue that caused connectors to not be visible in certain situations

notes.title: Early Access is Now Available!
notes.content:
The time has come, Commander.  Industrial Annihilation is out now in Steam Early Access!  From the creators of Planetary Annihilation and Total Annihilation, experience iconic real-time strategy action and deep factory-building gameplay in a unique blend of genres.

[previewyoutube=9oIWmQRo6aU;full][/previewyoutube]
Fair warning: We’ve launched into Early Access on the earlier side of the development cycle in order to involve our community when we can best affect balance and design changes.  That means everything is in early stages including gameplay, visuals, audio, and game balance. The chances of running into bugs are also high.

We want to be as transparent as possible about what we’re working on during Early Access, and the roadmap below is our current best detailed assessment of what we are working on to continue building and polishing the Industrial Annihilation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136495/f872a6069d617c0c9b90d9b5ea1e4cba7388428a.png[/img]
If you still want to be part of this community, discuss the plans on our roadmap, and jump into the game, we’d love to have you - we will be actively listening to feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/indann]Discord[/url]. This would be the best place for our players to get the fastest response by the dev team and community on any feedback. 

Thank you for all of your support, we couldn’t reach this stage without you.  We’ll see you on the battlefield, Commanders!

notes.title: Early Access Arrives on Dec 10th!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Industrial Annihilation is coming to Steam Early Access on December 10th!  We’d be honored if you’d join us in this Early Access journey.  Experience real-time strategy action from the team that brought you the Annihilation universe combined with deep factory building. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136495/5c2b12cc6e94b924c9a32b88543b1aebad2b88d2.png[/img]

Be sure to tell your friends and wishlist the game on Steam to be ready to go on launch day!

To get access to the dev team and unique insights and sneak peeks into the game, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/indann]Discord[/url] ahead of launch.
